entry_state: Typed requests, layered results, immutable corrections and atomic durability requirements now preserve the earlier financial meanings. Plugin interfaces must expose material inputs and retain unknown solver regions. Human review and recovery are next.
exit_state: Review and identity rules preserve original sources and historical decisions. The adapter discussion now distinguishes visible content, actual processed pages, model files, table geometry and transformed inline readings; source inspection has not become runtime validation.
findings: Model-generated readings remain proposals after deterministic checks; token confidence cannot supply economic-history weights.
Correction of OCR120 versus720 differs from an issuer correction120 to110; historical outputs retain their own evidence.
Event lookup and full request fingerprint have different roles; order-independent random keys are explicitly fixtures, not assessed production generators.
The rendered HSBC title and hidden extracted year motivate distinct raw and visible readings. Docling partial success and absent OCR preserve actual processing coverage.
The OTSL L-shaped counterexample motivates rectangular occupancy checks beyond printed local token rules; inline transformed values must not be scaled again.
